original_test_intent: Measure CE- and SM-driven CUDA P2P latency, bandwidth and data integrity for every required directed GPU pair and preserve characterization data until engineering defines acceptance.
original_method: Pin vendor P2P module/config; map GPU UUID/BDF/NUMA/NVLink/PCIe topology and required directed pairs; allocate isolated buffers; approve sizes/iterations/warmup/directions and load window; run CE and SM modes separately; verify patterns; retain per-pair metrics/errors/telemetry; do not assign DUT PASS without an approved oracle.
manual_activity: GPU/performance owner selects pair scope and accepts characterization thresholds; operator approves load and isolated buffers.
required_inputs: CE/SM transfer sizes, directions, iterations and warmup
Safe buffer ownership and integrity pattern
Per-pair latency/bandwidth/integrity oracle or characterization-only disposition
safety_requirements: Do not infer peer capability from adjacency or index
Preserve unsupported/asymmetric pairs and transfer errors
Do not clear logs, change topology or auto-retry
agent_execution_scope: Run one bounded CE and SM campaign
engineer_actions: Approve pairwise oracle or accept characterization-only status

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce directed matrices for capability, CE/SM latency, bandwidth, integrity and topology class.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds reproducible parameters and safe data while preserving the missing verdict boundary.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Collectives or host-device DMA do not prove direct peer paths or both engine modes.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: P2P may route through NVLink, PCIe switch or host path; topology groups need different expectations.
